strategies.name: Detection of System Runtime API Hijacking

analytics.name: Analytic 1800
analytics.guidance: Correlates (1) modification or replacement of system runtime libraries or API resolution paths, (2) repeated invocation of hijacked APIs across multiple applications, and (3) inconsistent or suppressed outputs from those APIs compared to expected OS-enforced behavior. The defender observes a causal chain where system-level API behavior is altered, resulting in multiple applications exhibiting consistent anomalies in sensor access, permission checks, or system state reporting.

tuning.description: Correlation window across multiple applications invoking affected APIs
Set of APIs monitored for integrity (e.g., location, telephony, permission checks)
Number of applications required to exhibit anomalous API behavior to trigger detection
Baseline of expected API return values or behavior patterns per device state

log_sources.name: MobileEDR:telemetry
log_sources.channel: multiple applications invoking core system APIs (e.g., sensor, permission, telephony) with abnormal or inconsistent return values across apps within short interval

log_sources.name: MobileEDR:telemetry
log_sources.channel: device integrity degradation + root detected or system partition modification affecting runtime libraries (e.g., /system/lib*, /vendor/lib*)
